limits: Different model from the four-player finite-randomization example; does not replace its exact analysis.
Expected observed-ratio discussion restricted to positive-total samples; no zero substitute for undefined ratios.
K-1 convention is not an exact finite-sample unbiasedness guarantee.
Zero fitted residual variance is not proof of no population variation.
No real player data, production statistics, confidence interval, p-value, sample-size or launch decision.
